title: Invoice numbering
skill: Name both symptoms and the rule behind them

good: Fix nextInvoiceNumber(last, date) in src/invoices/numbering.js. Parse last with /^INV-(\d{4})-(\d+)$/ instead of last.slice(-4). Rules: format INV-YYYY-NNNN where YYYY is date.getUTCFullYear(); the counter is last's counter + 1; if last is null or its year is not the year of date, the counter is 1; pad the counter to at least 4 digits with padStart(4, "0") and never cut it, so INV-2026-9999 is followed by INV-2026-10000, then INV-2026-10001. Do not change other files. Then run: node --test --test-reporter=tap test/*.test.js
lazy: Invoice numbers are wrong sometimes, fix it.
